subject: Newton Labs discovery → pilot charter and access ops
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Patel <emma@newtonlabs.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@newtonlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Newton discovery → pilot charter and access ops

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared playbook for a short pilot. High level: Newton wants to validate a summary- and classification-based assistant for internal research docs, with a focus on latency and redaction controls.

Key pain / goals you shared:
- Search & summarization of internal research notes is slow and inconsistent; reviewers spend ~2 hrs/day on triage.
- Must redact PII and customer identifiers before any external model interactions.
- Target inference SLA: 95th pct latency < 600ms for single-document summarize calls; throughput for batch jobs ~30 qps during business hours.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in reviewer time and F1 >= 0.9 on the classification eval for redaction detection.

Pilot proposal (week 0–6):
1) Scope: 2 endpoints — document-summarize (few-shot prompts) and pii-detect/classify. We will run with an open Llama-x variant (quantized) on a dedicated pool.
2) Owners: Newton: Emma (product), Liam (infra). Redwood: Marissa (Eng PM), Karthik (Solutions).
3) Access & data: Newton provides a 500-doc prompt set (anonymized) + access to a staging S3 bucket; see attached network-access-template.csv for firewall egress rules.
4) Eval & success: Weekly evals using the provided prompt set; initial baseline round in week 1, regression checks on every rollout.
5) Timeline: Kickoff week of 18 May; week 2 baseline eval; week 4 model tuning and caching config; week 6 acceptance review.

Open asks for the kickoff email:
- Emma: confirm S3 staging path and an IAM role or short-lived creds (we prefer an IAM role with read-only).
- Liam: list of IPs/firewall admins for outbound TLS to redwood-managed endpoints.
- Newton: share a short sample of 20 documents that include redaction edge cases by EOD Thu (14 May).

I've attached a one-page pilot charter (v1) for you to review. If that looks good, we'll schedule a 30-min kickoff next Wednesday (20 May) to handoff to Eng and Security.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Patel <emma@newtonlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@newtonlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Newton discovery → pilot charter and access ops

Thanks Karthik — this is a clean summary and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

1) IAM: we can spin up a short-lived service account with read-only access to a staging bucket. I'll have our infra team create creds and share via our secure vault. ETA: Tue 14 May EOD.
2) Firewall: Liam will share the list of outbound IPs — we have a perimeter team that manages the firewall.
3) Sample docs: I'll push 20 examples (anonymized) to the staging bucket by EOD Thu.

On metrics, FYI we've historically measured reviewer time with a per-ticket timecard; we'll give you a 4-week baseline so the 30% reduction target is trackable. Regarding latency: 600ms 95th is aggressive but reasonable for single-document calls — appreciate the explicit SLO.

We can do the kickoff on Wed 20 May at 10am PT. Would Marissa and Karthik be available?

Best,
Emma

--
Emma Patel
Head of Product, Newton Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Newton discovery → pilot charter and access ops

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Emma's confirmation. Action items for ops & security before kickoff: 

- Neha: please review the attached network-access-template.csv and confirm the exact outbound IPs we will use from Redwood Dedicated (we may need to open a CIDR for their perimeter). Also, flag any additional KMS/HSM requirements; Newton said they prefer short-lived creds but we should confirm encryption-at-rest expectations.
- Marissa: please own the internal kickoff agenda — I'll handoff baseline eval tasking and prompt-set review to you. Add Eng owner for caching config and quantization tests (suggest Rodrigo from infra).

I stamped the pilot-charter-v1 (attached). We'll iterate but get the kickoff scheduled for 20 May 10am PT and load the baseline prompt set in week 1.

Emma / Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming kickoff: Wed 20 May, 10:00am PT (Zoom link to follow). Attendees: Emma, Liam, Newton infra lead (TBD); Karthik, Marissa, Neha, Rodrigo (Infra).

Pre-kickoff checklist (please action before the call):
- Newton: upload 20 sample docs (anonymized) to the staging bucket and provide read-only creds or role grant by Tue 14 May EOD.
- Newton: provide firewall contact or admin email so Neha can coordinate IP exceptions.
- Redwood: we'll upload pilot-charter-v1 to shared Drive and add a short runbook section for secret handling.

Initial ownership & points of contact:
- Pilot PM: Marissa Cole (redwood) — contact: marissa@redwood.ai
- Solutions lead: Karthik Iyer (redwood)
- Infra lead (Newton): Liam O'Connor
- Security/Network (redwood): Neha Kapoor

Acceptance checkpoints we will use during the pilot:
- Week 1 baseline eval: compare summary quality and redaction recall against Newton's labels.
- Week 3 tuning: update batching/caching profile and quantization; measure 95th pct latency.
- Week 6 acceptance review: run full prompt-set eval and discuss go/no-go.

I've attached pilot-charter-v1 and the network-access-template.csv for your team. If Newton confirms the creds and firewall contact by Tue EOD, we'll proceed with the kickoff and baseline imports on Wed.

Looking forward — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Eng Program Manager, Redwood Inference
